history.period: Modern temple; legend of folk origin
history.summary: TOWN/DISTRICT CORRECTED: Ganga Maiya Temple stands at Jhalmala village, 4 km east of Balod on the Durg-Balod road. The CSV's town 'Durg' is outdated - the site is near Balod town in Balod district (carved out of Durg district in 2012, which explains older sources listing Durg). Legend: a fisherman repeatedly netted an idol in the village pond; after Goddess Ganga appeared in a tribal villager's dream, the idol was enshrined in a hut; it was first given temple form by Bhikam Chand Tawri and repeatedly renovated since. The deity is worshipped as a perennial water body in the sanctum, believed self-manifested (swayambhu). Thousands visit during the two Navratris, many walking barefoot from long distances; the temple trust runs free medical camps and cultural events.
